policy: Run focused compilation and boundary checks during implementation. Independent testing and checked global proofs remain required for final acceptance.

obligations.required: Run the new comparator session against a real digest-pinned Linux producer and pinned actual kernel providers, exercise hostile exports and runtime escape/cleanup cases, and supply provider/runtime hardening evidence. Current decoder/session tests use mock kernels and container orchestration; no formal theorem or real sandbox assurance follows.

Exercise the actual generated compiler and pinned provider through production checked service, cross-session replay, policy mutation, rejection, target routing, revocation and closure; audit every production import path.
Lean-check the semantic environment model, full algorithmic-defeq soundness, cache refinement and checker soundness, with explicit theory and assumption closure.

Lean-check global erasure/specialization preservation, or independently validate every actual transformation under a precisely declared supported contract. Existing local slices do not discharge this obligation.
Check complete supported backend semantics, differential/adversarial corpora, artifact validators and ABI adapters; unsupported slices must fail closed.

Re-run full JS, Wasm and Rust fixed points after implementation repairs. Rust run 37516533780 at 0849ae7 passed generation and fixture execution, then generation-2 native compilation overflowed the stack. Generation/instantiation alone is insufficient.
Produce B9 diverse bootstrap and B10 verified bootstrap evidence with actual toolchain independence vectors and artifact identities.
Exercise all declared resource limits, cancellation, malformed inputs, cycles, large/deep certificates, cache poisoning and small-to-larger budget behavior; prove monotonicity only if Lean checks it.
Replay real proof/validator certificates, trust closure and pinned archives offline; metadata/hash closure is insufficient.
Freeze and seal actual tasks independently, run all ablations and resource accounting, and publish reproducible evidence without making holdout searchable to the factory.
Assess every V3 acceptance criterion using actual artifacts, independent validators or Lean-checked theorems as required; milestone source scans are not final evidence.
